source: Existing SupportMetrics.report, with existing cohort and case authorization semantics
authorization: Each explicit opaque store scope is revalidated against current canonical permissions and agency delegation on every request. Inaccessible selections are excluded without identifying hidden stores. Duplicate included stores are rejected.
aggregation: At most 20 stores. Sum fixed count/denominator fields; calculate rates from summed counts, not averages. Missing, pending, unavailable and immature follow-up remain explicit. No persisted cache.
drilldown: Requires current agency and support.analytics plus unrestricted store case.read/support.read/resource.read; case-specific permission checks remain in SupportMetrics.

tests.targeted_fault: A cached real aggregate ignores membership revocation and fails the independent post-revocation denominator.
